TtcanDrv shall provide information from the TTCAN Controller about the timing parameters (see [SWS_TtCan_00090]), the synchronization state and the master state (see [SWS_TtCan_00091]).

TtcanDrv shall provide means to influence the timing parameters of a TTCAN Controller (see [SWS_TtCan_00096], [SWS_TtCan_00097], [SWS_TtCan_00098], [SWS_TtCan_00099]) during runtime, if the TTCAN Controller acts as Time Master.
TtcanDrv shall provide the functionality of a timer, which is based on the time marks of the communication system, provided by the TTCAN Controller.
TtcanDrv shall support event-synchronized communication (see [SWS_TtCan_00094], [SWS_TtCan_00095]) (refer to [1, ISO 11898-4]).
